zh: 修复宿主 0.2.3 起带搜索框的工作区菜单无法被识别的问题，悬停展开后指针穿越触发按钮与卡片之间的间隙时弹层保持展开，卡片恢复皮肤落位与文件夹菜单样式
en: Fix the workspace menu with a search field going unrecognized since host 0.2.3, keeping the hover-opened popup up while the pointer crosses the air between trigger and card and restoring the skin's placement and folder-menu look
